info.description: Shared wardrobe and assistant API for web and native mobile clients. Authentication is an optional deployment-level shared access code, not per-user identity. Relative media URLs require the same access credentials. Conversation responses are newline-delimited JSON, not SSE. In Swagger UI, click Authorize and enter the shared access code under ShadowAccessHeader (without a Bearer prefix). Then use Try it out. GET /api/services/status explains missing configuration and recent service errors. Executing generation endpoints can incur provider charges. Authorization is not persisted across page reloads.
info.title: SHADOW API

post.description:
Stream UTF-8 newline-delimited JSON, one complete object per line.

Append text chunks, update tool status by ID, render outfit cards and offer
action routes without automatically launching cameras or paid generation.
Only `done` confirms success: save its conversation_id for the next turn.
An `error` is terminal even when HTTP status is 200; EOF without either is
an interrupted turn. Error codes are stable machine-readable categories;
`retryable` permits an explicit retry, not automatic replay of actions.
Sessions are ephemeral server memory; omitting the ID starts a new session.

schema.title: Response 200 Converse Api Conversation Post

200.description: UTF-8 NDJSON stream. Each line is one event from this union, not a JSON array. Ends with done or error; HTTP 200 alone does not mean the turn succeeded.
